children: Binance Wallet announced on X that its wallet services are not supervised by a regulatory authority. The notice said users are solely responsible for their access to or use of dApps through Binance Wallet and should conduct their own research before using the service. It also stated that the information provided is not financial advice. The announcement directed users to review the Terms of Use and Risk Warning before using Binance Wallet.

title: Binance Wallet States Its Services Are Not Supervised by a Regulatory Authority
